svg.title: Disagreement classifier — rules that fire
svg.desc: Compact top-down flowchart of the disagreement classifier showing only the rules that classify at least one language. Rules 1, 3, and 7 are omitted because their predicates are never satisfied on this dataset. Rule 8 is shown because it fires when keyword rules are enabled, re-routing 25 languages from rule 9 to rule 8. Canonical run uses keyword rules disabled.
svg.text: First rule whose predicate fires assigns the category. 857 languages × Digital Humanities.

g.text: Keyword rule — off canonical, +25 with kw
